meaning: A machine with keys that prints inked letters onto paper, one at a time, so you can write words.
clues: Each key you press makes a tiny hammer hit an inked ribbon and print one letter on paper.
The paper wraps around a roller that turns to move the page up one line.
At the end of a line, you push a lever to slide the carriage back to the start.
A small bell rings when you are close to the end of a line.
It has one word, with ten letters, and starts with T.

decoys.meaning: A copier that pushes ink through a typed stencil to make many paper copies.
A machine with number keys that adds figures and prints them on a paper tape.
A machine that records a person's speech so it can be played back or typed up later.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Each key made a real mark on paper. A clear paper copy is still useful when you need to read every word.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Today's version: a computer keyboard puts letters on a screen, and you can print the page.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: The ribbon and paper showed your work right away. There was no waiting for a machine to catch up.
